rules.text: Machines purchased from Dyson.com must be returned within 30 days from the delivery date for a full refund.
rules.quote: To return a machine purchased from Dyson.com for a full refund, you must return the machine within 30 days from the delivery date.

rules.text: Machines purchased at a Dyson Demo Store or Dyson Service Center must be returned within 30 days from the purchase date.
rules.quote: For machine purchases made at a Dyson Demo Store or Dyson Service Center, the return must be made within 30 days from the purchase date.

rules.text: Eligible machines returned to Dyson Direct will receive a full refund to the original payment method.
rules.quote: Eligible machines returned to Dyson Direct will receive a full refund to the original payment method, and Dyson Direct will pay for eligible standard return shipping.

rules.text: Dyson Direct will pay for eligible standard return shipping for machines.
rules.quote: Dyson Direct will pay for eligible standard return shipping.

rules.text: Dyson headphones have a 14-day refund policy from the delivery date.
rules.quote: Dyson headphones have a 14-day refund policy from the delivery date.

rules.text: Dyson headphones purchased at a Dyson Demo Store or Dyson Service Center must be returned within 14 days from the purchase date.
rules.quote: If purchased at a Dyson Demo Store or Dyson Service Center, the return must be made within 14 days from the purchase date.

rules.text: Dyson Oral Care Devices may be returned for a change of mind within 30 days from the delivery date if unopened and unused.
rules.quote: Dyson Oral Care Devices may be returned for a change of mind within 30 days from the delivery date or, if purchased at a Dyson Demo Store or Dyson Service Center, within 30 days from the purchase date.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that the 30-day window applies to both delivery date (online) and purchase date (in-store), while the quote includes both scenarios.

rules.text: Dyson Oral Care Devices must remain unopened and unused to qualify for a change-of-mind return.
rules.quote: To qualify for a change-of-mind return, the product must remain unopened and unused.

rules.text: Personalized accessories and accompanying machines cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged once the order is placed.
rules.quote: Personalized accessories and accompanying machines cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged once your order is placed.

rules.text: Dyson Outlet refurbished machines and Final Sale machines are final sale and not eligible for change-of-mind returns.
rules.quote: Dyson Outlet refurbished machines and Final Sale machines, including the first-generation Dyson Airwrap, are final sale and are not eligible for change-of-mind returns.

rules.text: Please allow 4–8 weeks for return processing.
rules.quote: Please allow 4–8 weeks for return processing.

rules.text: Eligible Dyson formulation products may be refunded or replaced within 60 days from the date of purchase.
rules.quote: If you are not satisfied with an eligible Dyson formulation product purchased from the Dyson website, you may request a refund or replacement within 60 days from the date of purchase.
